title: Modern Baseball Player Stats Dashboard
description: A responsive dashboard displaying baseball player statistics including batting average, home runs, RBIs, and recent game performance. Composed of a player profile card, stats table, and performance chart.

components.name: AvatarImage
components.description: Circular player profile photo with fallback initials if image is unavailable.

src.description: URL of the player's profile photo

alt.description: Alt text for the player image

initials.description: Fallback initials displayed when image is unavailable

layout.tailwind: flex items-center justify-center rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 text-gray-600 font-bold shrink-0

components.name: StatBadge
components.description: A small pill-shaped badge displaying a single stat label and its value, used in profile cards and summary rows.

layout.tailwind: inline-flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg gap-0.5 min-w-[64px]

components.name: TrendIndicator
components.description: An up/down arrow icon with color indication showing whether a stat trend is positive, negative, or neutral.

value.description: Optional delta value to display alongside the arrow (e.g. '+0.025')

components.name: SectionHeading
components.description: A styled section title with an optional subtitle, used to label dashboard panels.

components.name: PlayerProfileCard
components.description: A card displaying the player's photo, name, team, position, and key summary stats (batting average, home runs, RBIs). Acts as a quick-glance identity and highlight panel.

rbi.description: Total runs batted in this season

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center sm:items-start gap-5 p-6 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-md border border-gray-100 w-full

children.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-1 flex-1 text-center sm:text-left
flex flex-row sm:flex-col gap-3 flex-wrap justify-center sm:justify-end

components.name: StatsTableRow
components.description: A single row inside the stats table representing one statistical category with its value, season rank, and trend.

rank.description: Player's rank among all players for this stat (optional)

isHighlighted.description: Whether this row is highlighted as a top stat

layout.tailwind: grid grid-cols-[2fr_1fr_1fr_1fr] items-center px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors duration-150

components.name: StatsTable
components.description: A full stats table listing all key batting and fielding statistics for the player. Includes column headers (Stat, Value, Trend, Rank) and a list of StatsTableRow components.

stats.description: Array of stat objects: [{ statLabel, statKey, value, rank, trend, delta }]

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-md border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden

children.tailwind: grid grid-cols-[2fr_1fr_1fr_1fr] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-gray-100 bg-gray-50

emptyState.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 text-gray-400 gap-2

components.name: GameResultBadge
components.description: A small colored pill showing the result of a single game (Win / Loss / No Decision) alongside the player's performance highlight.

layout.tailwind: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold

components.name: PerformanceChartBar
components.description: A single vertical bar in the performance chart representing one game's stat value (e.g. hits). Height scales proportionally to the maximum value.

maxValue.description: Maximum stat value across all displayed games (used to normalize bar height)

label.description: X-axis label (e.g. game date or opponent abbreviation)

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center justify-end gap-1 cursor-pointer group

components.name: PerformanceChartTooltip
components.description: A floating tooltip shown on hover over a chart bar, displaying detailed stats for that game.

stats.description: Key-value stat pairs to display (e.g. { hits: 3, atBats: 4, rbi: 2 })

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-1 absolute z-10 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-xl px-3 py-2 shadow-xl pointer-events-none min-w-[120px] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-full

components.name: PerformanceChart
components.description: A bar chart showing the player's per-game performance over the last N games. Each bar represents a single game, color-coded by win/loss result. Includes a legend, axis labels, and an interactive tooltip.

games.description: Array of recent game objects: [{ date, opponent, result, hits, atBats, rbi, homeRuns }]

statKey.description: Which stat to visualize on the Y-axis (default: 'hits')

maxGames.description: Maximum number of recent games to display (default: 10)

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-4 p-6 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-md border border-gray-100 w-full

children.description: Tab/toggle buttons to switch the displayed stat (Hits, HR, RBI)

children.tailwind: px-3 py-1 text-sm rounded-full font-medium transition-colors
relative flex items-end justify-between gap-2 h-48 px-1

emptyState.tailwind: flex items-center justify-center h-48 text-gray-400 text-sm

accessibility.ariaLabel: Bar chart of player's recent game performance

components.name: DashboardHeader
components.description: Top navigation bar of the dashboard containing the app logo/title, season selector dropdown, and optional action buttons (e.g. Export, Share).

layout.tailwind: flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 bg-white border-b border-gray-200 shadow-sm sticky top-0 z-20 w-full

children.tailwind: text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 bg-white text-gray-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500
hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600 hover:text-blue-600 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors

components.name: PlayerStatsDashboard
components.description: Full-page layout template composing all dashboard organisms: header, player profile card, stats table, and performance chart. Handles responsive grid arrangement.

playerId.description: Unique identifier for the player whose data is displayed

isLoading.description: Whether the dashboard is in a loading state

hasError.description: Whether there was an error loading data

children.tailwind: flex-1 w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8

loadingState.description: Each card section replaced by a skeleton loader (animated pulse placeholder)

errorState.description: Full-page error message with retry button centered in the main area
errorState.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 text-center py-24 text-gray-500

components.name: PlayerStatsDashboardPage
components.description: The root page component. Manages routing, data fetching coordination, and renders the PlayerStatsDashboard template with all required data.

routeParams.description: URL route parameters including playerId and optional season

breakpoints.lg: 1024px — two-column grid for StatsTable and PerformanceChart
breakpoints.xl: 1280px — max content width cap at max-w-7xl

interactions.action: Show PerformanceChartTooltip with detailed game stats; highlight the bar with a ring outline.
Mark bar as active (persisted selection); display selected game detail in a sticky info strip below the chart.
Switch the Y-axis metric displayed in the chart (Hits / HR / RBI). Animate bar height transition.
Update dashboard data for the selected season; trigger loading skeleton state while fetching.
Highlight row background to bg-gray-50 for improved readability.
Open an export dialog or trigger a CSV/PDF download of the current stats table.
Show skeleton loaders for all sections while data is being fetched. Replace with actual content on success, or show error state on failure.
